propositions: LLMBudgetExhaustedError raised by interpret_failure budget branch is not caught by CompletionAgentStep.run's except clause because it only catches UnretryableOutputError, causing step-budget exhaustion to propagate instead of entering bounded recovery
Bounded completion recovery mechanism is unreachable for step-budget exhaustion because LLMRunnerError is a strict ancestor of UnretryableOutputError and the type hierarchy prevents matching
A new typed exception LLMBudgetExhaustedError(LLMRunnerError) must be created and raised from interpret_failure's budget branch to make budget exhaustion identifiable purely by type
CompletionAgentStep.run's except clause must be extended to catch LLMBudgetExhaustedError and route it to _recover to enable the bounded per-criterion recovery path
Budget diagnostic must be preserved on self.failure_diagnostic before recovery so that if recovery also fails, failure counters remain available for surfacing
Plain LLMRunnerError instances that are not the budget subclass must continue to propagate unchanged to maintain backward compatibility
